title: Write a Greeting File
prompt: Write the text Hello, Code Journey! (exactly, no trailing newline) into greeting.txt using a with-block. The test reads the file back.

tests.name: file has the right content
tests.code:
with open("greeting.txt", encoding="utf-8") as _f:
    _c = _f.read()
assert _c == "Hello, Code Journey!", f"file contains {_c!r}"
assert "with open" in code, "use a with-block"
tests.hint: with open("greeting.txt", "w", encoding="utf-8") as f: f.write("Hello, Code Journey!") — no \n in the text.
